question: In which of the following places were the 2021 World Artistic Gymnastics Championships held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kitakyushu, Japan**__:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The competition was originally scheduled to be held in Copenhagen, Denmark, before the Danish Gymnastics Federation withdrew from hosting in July 2020 and later **Kitakyushu **announced as the new hosting city.
 
• **China **top the medal tally with 5 Gold, 1 Silver and 2 Bronze.
 
• The first edition of the championships was held in **1903**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The **youngest **athlete in individual all rounder** men's** category was Eyal Indig (18 years).
 
• The **oldest **athlete in individual all rounder **men's** category was Nikita Ignatyev (29 years).
 
• **Zhang Boheng of China ranked 1st in all rounder men's category**.
 
• The **youngest **athlete in individual all rounder **women's **category was Jennifer Williams (16 years).
 
• The **oldest **athlete in individual all rounder **women's **category was Filipa Martins (25 years).
 
• **Angelina Melnikova of Russia ranked 1st in all rounder women's category**.
